exposure: c.335dupG (p.Cys112Trpfs*11) mutation in the SOD1 gene
cohort: Five Brazilian patients with SOD1 protein deficiency from a reference center for Neuromuscular Disorders.
finding: All five patients presented with childhood-onset neurodegenerative disorders characterized by spastic tetraplegia with axial hypotonia, often accompanied by polyhydramnios and intrauterine growth restriction, followed by a rapidly progressive motor decline, severe dysphagia, respiratory insufficiency, and cognitive impairment, all linked to homozygosity for the c.335dupG mutation in the SOD1 gene.
